location_exception_reason: Container conversions are B2B fabrication services with nationwide delivery and installation capability; location of the service provider does not materially change the product specification or buyer decision. Buyers select based on conversion type, fitout quality, and delivery timeline, not geographic origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type identifiers (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Service Provider) are redundant in titles because IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Service Provider' from a title leaves the product meaning unchanged: the container conversion itself is the product, not the business relationship.
